The Indian Coast Guard Assistant Commandant Merit List 2025 has been officially released. Candidates who appeared for the selection process can now check their final selection status. The merit list is published branch-wise and category-wise and includes both the Selected List and Waiting List.

This article explains the ICG AC Final Merit List PDF, download process, key details, and what candidates should do next, strictly based on the official notice.

Indian Coast Guard Assistant Commandant Merit List 2025 Out

The Indian Coast Guard has issued the Updated Final Merit List for Assistant Commandant – 2026 Course. The list has been revised after removing candidates who were unwilling to join or found medically unfit.

The merit list clearly mentions:

  • Selected candidates
  • Waiting list candidates
  • Medical fitness status
  • Appointment letter status

Only candidates fulfilling medical and willingness requirements have been issued appointment letters.

ICG AC Merit List 2025: Overview

Below is a quick overview of the Indian Coast Guard Assistant Commandant Merit List 2025:

Particulars Details
Organization Indian Coast Guard
Post Name Assistant Commandant
Course 2026 Course
Merit List Status Released
Merit List Type Final (Updated)
Selection Basis Order of Merit + Medical Fitness
Reporting Location Indian Naval Academy, Ezhimala
Official Mode PDF

The merit list is released separately for General Duty, Technical (Engineering/Mechanical), and Technical (Electrical/Electronics) branches.

Indian Coast Guard Assistant Commandant Final Merit List PDF

The ICG AC Final Merit List PDF is available through the official Indian Coast Guard recruitment portal.

The PDF contains:

  • Registration number
  • Candidate name
  • Category
  • Selection category
  • Medical fitness remarks

Candidates whose appointment letters have been issued are clearly marked in the remarks column.

Indian Coast Guard Assistant Commandant Merit List PDF – Click Here To Download

How To Download Indian Coast Guard AC Merit List PDF?

Follow these steps to download the Indian Coast Guard Assistant Commandant Merit List 2025:

  1. Visit the official Indian Coast Guard recruitment website
  2. Open the “Assistant Commandant – 2026 Course” section
  3. Click on Updated Final Merit List notification
  4. Download the merit list PDF
  5. Search your registration number using Ctrl + F

Always verify your medical status and selection remarks carefully.

Details Mentioned On Indian Coast Guard Assistant Commandant Merit List 2025

The final merit list PDF includes the following details for each candidate:

  1. Registration Number
  2. Candidate Name
  3. Category (UR / OBC / SC / ST / EWS)
  4. Selection Category
  5. Branch (GD / Technical)
  6. Medical Fitness Status
  7. Appointment Letter Status

Medical status such as Fit, Medical in Progress (AMB/RMB), or Appointment Letter Issued is clearly specified.

What Next After ICG Assistant Commandant Result 2025

Candidates shortlisted in the Selected List must note the next steps carefully:

  • Appointment letters have been issued to candidates who submitted willingness and medical documents
  • Selected candidates must report to Indian Naval Academy, Ezhimala on 29 December 2025
  • A second induction date of 12 January 2026 is applicable for candidates completing medical formalities later
  • Waiting list candidates may be upgraded if selected candidates withdraw or are declared medically unfit

Selection from the waiting list is strictly based on merit order and medical fitness.

Indian Coast Guard Assistant Commandant Merit List PDF FAQs

Q1. Is the Indian Coast Guard Assistant Commandant Merit List 2025 released?

Ans: Yes, the updated final merit list for Assistant Commandant – 2026 Course has been released.

Q2. What does “Medical in Progress” mean in the merit list?

Ans: It indicates that the candidate’s medical review (AMB/RMB) is still pending.

Q3. Are appointment letters issued to all selected candidates?

Ans: Appointment letters are issued only to candidates who submitted willingness and complete medical documents.

Q4. What is the reporting date for selected candidates?

Ans: Selected candidates must report at Indian Naval Academy, Ezhimala on 29 December 2025.

Q5. Is there a waiting list in the ICG AC Merit List 2025?

Ans: Yes, a branch-wise and category-wise waiting list has been published.

Q6. Can waiting list candidates still get selected?

Ans: Yes, waiting list candidates may be upgraded if vacancies arise due to withdrawal or medical unfitness.

Q7. Will marks be disclosed for non-selected candidates?

Ans: Marks will be intimated later through individual login IDs after completion of induction formalities.
